notes.title: Necrophobia OST Update
notes.notes:
Remastered Songs:


 Introvert. (Kaelynn's Theme)
 Extrovert. (Chryssi's Theme)
 Benevolence. (Phoebe's Theme)
 Misconception. (Ixora's theme)
 Variations of said themes (Distorted versions used in moments of suspense)

Chryssi's grand chance to show off~

General Revisions:

 Fixes to typos, grammatical errors, and punctuation (Phoebe was embarrassed by how many she found >_<)
 Revised faulty sound effects


Appreciation and love to all those who've shown interest thus far and to all those who'll do so in the future!! I hope you enjoy~ <3
